g.text: Synthetic 48 × 72-pixel scene, 221 bands (0.40–2.60 µm), five endmembers with absorption bands at the positions of real minerals, linear (areal) mixing, noise SNR
150. FCLS = non-negative least squares with a sum-to-one row. Without the smectite spectrum, the residual map outlines where the library is incomplete. Seed 5154.
